name: After § 1
title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on Moldova
part_text: 1a. Expresses serious concern at the persistently high level of corruption in Moldova, as reflected in the 2025 Corruption Perceptions Index; calls on the Commission and the Council to end all further financial commitments and any advancement of Moldova’s accession process; stresses that EU taxpayers’ money must not be used to subsidise systemic corruption;
